hints.title: Cost per Insertion
hints.text: The insertion cost of element x is the minimum of counts of elements strictly less than x and strictly greater than x.

hints.title: Binary Indexed Tree for Dynamic Frequency
hints.text: Maintain frequency counts of elements dynamically in a Fenwick tree or segment tree.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Query
hints.text: Query prefix sum up to x - 1 for elements smaller than x and total minus query up to x for elements greater than x.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def createSortedArray(self, instructions: list[int]) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        MAX_VAL = max(instructions) + 1
        tree = [0] * (MAX_VAL + 1)

        def update(idx: int, val: int) -> None:
            while idx <= MAX_VAL:
                tree[idx] += val
                idx += idx & (-idx)

        def query(idx: int) -> int:
            s = 0
            while idx > 0:
                s += tree[idx]
                idx -= idx & (-idx)
            return s

        total_cost = 0
        for i, x in enumerate(instructions):
            less = query(x - 1)
            greater = i - query(x)
            total_cost = (total_cost + min(less, greater)) % MOD
            update(x, 1)
        return total_cost
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Maintaining a sorted list via insertion requires O(n^2) array shifts.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A Fenwick tree over coordinate range 1..100,000 allows O(log M) query and update.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should identify Fenwick tree or Segment tree as the optimal data structure for prefix rank queries.
